# MCPify on inc42.si — Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Bridge & Generator

> MCPify (https://inc42.si) is the open-source bridge and generator that converts any AI agent URL, REST API, GraphQL API, or OpenAPI specification into a fully compliant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

## Overview
MCPify connects external APIs and AI agents to modern AI assistants including Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and VS Code via dual-mode HTTP Streamable and Server-Sent Events (SSE) MCP endpoints.

- **Primary Website**: https://inc42.si
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mrdevpatmase/mcpify
- **License**: MIT
- **Key Features**:
  - Auto-detection of AI Agent frameworks (FastAPI MCP, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
  - OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger spec parser to MCP tool definitions
  - GraphQL schema & mutation to MCP tool conversion
  - Live proxy engine wrapping REST APIs into hosted SSE and HTTP MCP endpoints
  - One-click configuration generators for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and VS Code

## API & Endpoints
- **Web App**: https://inc42.si/
- **Login**: https://inc42.si/login
- **Signup**: https://inc42.si/signup
- **OpenAPI Docs**: https://inc42.si/docs
- **Health Check**: https://inc42.si/health
- **Sitemap**: https://inc42.si/sitemap.xml
- **Robots**: https://inc42.si/robots.txt

## How to Use MCPify
1. Visit https://inc42.si
2. Enter your target REST API endpoint, OpenAPI schema URL, or AI agent URL.
3. Click "Generate MCP Config".
4. Copy the generated JSON snippet directly into `claude_desktop_config.json` or Cursor MCP settings.
